# Product Naming

## Overview
This page compiles internal brainstorming sessions, rejected concepts, taglines, and backlog notes regarding product naming, taglines, and associated [hardware](./hardware.md) and software ideas. 

## Key Details
- **Approved Names:** 
  - *[Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md)* (kept)
  - *[Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md)* (kept)
- **Rejected Names:** 
  - *SoilPal*
  - *GritNode*
  - *PetalPing*
  - *CloudFree Sensor* (noted as "too on the nose")
  - *KarpathyGarden* (noted with confusion)
  - *[MeshSync](./meshsync.md)* renamed to *MeshSink* was explicitly rejected three times.
- **Taglines Tested:**
  - "Sense without surrender" (critiqued as "cringe")
  - "Your data, your dirt" (critiqued as "worse")
  - "Open [sensors](./sensors.md) for people who own their data" (considered the best option)
- **Internal Disagreements:** Team members Jonah and [Mira](./aurora-nova-widget-v2.md) hold conflicting preferences regarding the hardware form factor, with Jonah advocating for a pebble shape and Mira preferring a hexagonal form factor.

## Contradictions
&gt; **Contradiction:** The backlog notes mention an attempt to rename "MeshSync" to "MeshSink", yet explicitly state that this idea has been "rejected 3x", highlighting an internal tug-of-war or recurring bad idea surfacing in the unsorted junk drawer.
